title: Plus Size Lace Sleepwear Set — 1X to 3X | Dusty Rose | Plus Size
description:
Plus size lingerie is usually a smaller design scaled up, which puts the stress in the wrong places — straps too short, gusset too small, proportions off at the bust. These are developed as their own sizes from the start, with the same fabric and construction as the standard range.

The cami has a slightly longer torso so it does not ride up, and the gusset is sized up in both dimensions rather than just being cut from a bigger panel.

Extended sizing runs 1X to 3X. If you are between standard sizes and between extended sizes, the standard range tends to fit better — going up a size changes more than the label suggests.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• 1X-3X extended sizing, developed separately from standard sizes
• Longer torso length so the cami does not ride up
• Gusset sized up in both dimensions, not just cut from a larger panel
• Same fabric and construction as the standard range
• Adjustable straps with extra-long adjustment range

DETAILS
• Material: 88% Nylon, 12% Spandex with lace trim; cotton gusset
• Color: Dusty Rose
• Closure: Adjustable straps; pull-on bottoms
• Pattern: Lace trim on solid
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Hang to dry.

FIT & SIZING
Extended sizing runs true. If you are between a standard size and an extended size, the standard range usually fits better.
Model is 5'9" (175 cm) with a 40" bust and 36" waist, wearing size 1X.

SIZING (body measurements)
Size | Bust | Underbust | Waist | Hip | Weight (lb) | Equivalent to
1X | 40–42 in | 36–38 in | 34–36 in | 45–47 in | 215–245 lb | US 18–20
2X | 43–45 in | 39–41 in | 37–39 in | 48–50 in | 245–275 lb | US 20–22
3X | 46–48 in | 42–44 in | 40–42 in | 51–53 in | 275–305 lb | US 24–26

Sizing tips:
• Extended sizes are cut longer through the torso, not just wider. Most standard sleepwear rides up on a longer torso — these do not.
• The gusset is sized up in both dimensions. Gussets cut from a larger panel of standard fabric stay uncomfortable; ours are drafted larger.
• Straps have an extended adjustment range. If you have been shortening straps by sewing them in previous purchases, you will not need to here.
• Between 1X and 2X? Go by hip. If you are roughly equal between the two, 2X gives a more relaxed fit through the seat.
• Between a standard XL and a 1X? Take the standard XL. The step up to extended sizing changes more than the measurements suggest.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: How are the plus sizes cut?
A: They are developed as their own sizes rather than scaled up from the standard range. The torso is longer and the gusset is bigger in both dimensions.

Q: What if I am between a standard size and an extended size?
A: Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes more than the label implies — torso length, gusset volume, and strap range all change.

Q: Is the set see-through?
A: The body is opaque. Lace trim is used at the neckline and hem only, rather than as an all-over panel.

Q: Do the straps run short on extended sizes?
A: No. The straps have an extended adjustment range specifically for the larger torso length.

Shipping: We ship from New Jersey. Orders are processed in 1-2 business days and typically arrive within 2-4 business days after dispatch. Orders over $59 ship free within the US.

Returns: We accept returns within 30 days, unworn with tags attached, and return shipping is on us. If you need a different size, message us with your measurements and we will help.

Support replies within 24 hours, every day of the week. care@lumencie.com
